assertions.title: Provider-aware file search stays pinned to the originating provider

steps.action: Enable File Search in /c/new and upload provider-pin-note.txt (Upload to Provider)
steps.expected: File indexed for provider-aware file_search and retrievable
steps.observed: Chat response stated missing attachment in file-search query flow ("I don’t see any attached file in this chat")

steps.action: Inspect uploaded file records via GET /api/files
steps.expected: metadata.ragProvider and metadata.ragModel persisted for file_search file
steps.observed: provider-pin-note.txt records lacked ragProvider/ragModel and had empty text/embedded metadata

evidence.network: POST /api/files + chat request via UI; API metadata probe in evidence file shows missing ragProvider/ragModel for provider-pin-note.txt

assertions.issues: Provider-pin metadata contract not met in observed user/API surface: file_search upload did not persist ragProvider/ragModel and retrieval flow reported missing attachment.

assertions.title: Context-mode screenshots preserve both vision input and OCR text

steps.action: Disable File Search, choose Upload as Text, upload login-page.png screenshot
steps.expected: Image remains attached for vision and OCR text stored on same file record
steps.observed: Image preview attachment rendered in composer/message UI (vision input preserved)

steps.action: Ask model to read words from uploaded image
steps.expected: Readable OCR-derived content from screenshot text
steps.observed: Model reported corrupted PNG dump markers (IDAT/IEND) instead of OCR text

evidence.network: POST /api/files (Upload as Text) then chat completion; GET /api/files shows empty text

assertions.issues: OCR-preservation portion failed: uploaded image stayed attachable, but OCR text was not persisted/injected (empty file.text; corrupted PNG marker output).

assertions.title: Background transcription shows progress/completion metadata in place

steps.expected: transcriptionStatus lifecycle reflected in metadata and unfinished=false

steps.expected: Reject non-audio and clips outside 2-10s, accept valid clips, max 4 clips

assertions.issues: Diarization handoff from /c/new is broken with speaker references in this run: conversation save cast error leads to invalid conversation-id toast and non-renderable conversation route.
